minimum_plan_delta: Add the actual local command: name, file-path argument, and registration in the existing CLI entrypoint.
Specify read/write behavior (load the file, run the formatter, write the result) and failure handling for a missing or unreadable path.
Reuse existing CLI/test/doc patterns instead of inventing a new command shape.
missing: No step wires a user-invocable command; a formatter function alone does not add the command.
No file I/O or overwrite-vs-stdout behavior.
No error path for missing, unreadable, or non-Markdown input.
Formatting rules are unspecified beyond 'headings and lists' in one test.
risks: Undefined format semantics can rewrite files in unexpected ways if the command writes in place.
A single headings/lists fixture will not lock other Markdown constructs the formatter may still touch.
user_decisions: Whether the command overwrites the file in place or prints formatted Markdown to stdout.
Which heading/list conventions the formatter should enforce, if the repo has no existing standard.
